description: Full documentation for remote-store: tutorials, how-to guides, API reference, and design explanations. Write file storage code once, run it against local files, S3, SFTP, or Azure.
rules: Docs follow the Diataxis framework: tutorials for learning by doing, guides for task-focused how-tos, reference for API detail, explanation for architecture and design rationale.
Tutorial: the hands-on intro to remote-store. By the end you'll have a working Store reading and writing files, and the rest of the docs will make sense.
Guides: recipes for the things you'll actually do — pick a backend, add caching, stream big files, plug into PyArrow or Dagster. One page, one task.
Reference: the complete one — exact and searchable. Come here when you know what you need or like to dig into.
Explanation: why remote-store is shaped the way it is — the reasoning behind design choices, not just what they are. Read when 'how' isn't enough.
Guide: Build Your Own Backend walks through implementing a custom Backend (Redis example) that plugs into Store, Registry, and every extension in the ecosystem.
Guide: Data Lake Patterns — remote-store as the I/O layer under Delta Lake, Iceberg, and Parquet. Develop against MemoryBackend locally, deploy to S3 or Azure without changing application code.
Guide: Parquet Datasets — managed Parquet datasets with manifests, completion markers, and multi-part layouts using ext.parquet.ParquetDatasetStore.

Extensions guide: ext.batch for bulk ops, ext.cache for TTL caching, ext.observe for I/O hooks, ext.transfer for cross-store copy, ext.arrow as a PyArrow FileSystem adapter — no backend changes needed.
RetryPolicy provides unified retry configuration across backends; each backend maps it to its native retry mechanism, avoiding retry multiplication.
